verdict.rationale: Stripe's stablecoin docs explicitly list the supported coins and named networks: USDC on Tempo, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and Base, USDP on Ethereum and Solana (US-only), and USDG on Ethereum (US-only). Payouts and the x402 flow also reference USDC. USDT, which the story explicitly names, appears nowhere, and the two other peers are US-restricted, which limits matching what global customers hold. Missing for 10: USDT support, non-US availability for USDP/USDG, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the coin/chain matrix.
